title: Tempest 2000
overview:
The Legend Continues...

It's been 15 years since you first took the controls of your Blaster ship and fried the aliens attacking your end of the web in the original Tempest. Now you're back - this time with more firepower, tricks up your sleeve, a trusty A.I. droid, and a slew of new enemies who want nothing more than to convert you to space dust. Can you make your heroic comeback and save the web... or will you die trying?

- Three incredible versions of the original legend: Tempest Plus, Tempest 2000 and Tempest Duel.
- Over 90 death-defying levels and the new bonus warp worlds 3D-style graphics and earth-shattering explosions that transform into dangerous geometric formations
- Riveting techno-rave CD-quality soundtrack
- 2-player mode: team up to pulverize or battle it out against each other
